text: Flags missing input validation on req.body — email, role, and teamId are trusted without sanitization or schema check
Flags the absent try/catch or error middleware — any db or email failure crashes the request with an unhandled rejection
Flags Math.random() for token generation as cryptographically insecure
Flags RequestData as a shallow name that mirrors prompt language rather than the domain concept (e.g., InvitationRequest or InvitePayload)
Flags InvitationService as a stateless class wrapper that adds indirection without value — a plain function would suffice
Findings are grouped under markdown headers that include category name and severity, e.g., '## Missing Skepticism (error)' or '## Shallow Naming (warn)'
Output ends with a summary line matching the pattern 'vibe-check: N errors, N warnings across N files'
Each finding includes a file:line reference like 'handler.ts:35' or 'src/config.py:12'
